verdict.rationale: Mollie explicitly documents hosted checkout and Mollie Components/Mollie JS as PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant, meaning card holder data fields are handled by Mollie's own iframe/JS layer so raw card data never touches the merchant's servers, keeping the developer's systems largely out of PCI scope. This is reinforced by the three documented integration depths (hosted checkout, Components, build-your-own via tokenized fields) explicitly framed as PCI scope reduction. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit or customer testimonial confirming SAQ-A scope reduction in practice beyond Mollie's own docs.
